title: Milling stability lobes
line: Chatter-free depth of cut against spindle speed.
description: Stability lobes for a milling spindle with one dominant mode (650 Hz, 2% damping, 50 N/um), three teeth, cutting stiffness 700 N/mm^2; single-mode model after Schmitz and Smith, Machining Dynamics.
thumbnailAlt: Stability lobe diagram of limiting depth of cut against spindle speed, rendered by RunMat
